description: This horizontal stacked bar chart, sourced from the paper "ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced Role-Playing Language Agents," illustrates the performance outcomes—specifically win, tie, and loss percentages—for three language models: Claude3.5, GPT4o, and Doubao. The vertical axis lists the models in descending order of their win rate, from top to bottom. The horizontal axis represents the cumulative probability scale from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. Each model’s bar is segmented into three colored portions corresponding to the legend: pink for “Win,” gray for “Tie,” and light green for “Lose.” For Claude3.5, the bar is divided into 32.0% win (pink), 44.0% tie (gray), and 24.0% loss (light green). For GPT4o, the segments are 56.0% win (pink), 18.0% tie (gray), and 26.0% loss (light green). For Doubao, the segments are 42.0% win (pink), 36.0% tie (gray), and 22.0% loss (light green). The bars are not sorted by any other metric, and no visual emphasis is applied to any specific bar or segment beyond the color-coded segmentation.
